semiconductor_relevance: High — Takachiho Trading specializes in the import, manufacturing, and servicing of gases for ion implantation, making it a key player in the semiconductor materials supply chain.
summary: Takachiho Trading is a leading provider of high-pressure gases for ion implantation, with a focus on domestically produced products in Japan. They offer proprietary gas sources and tailored gas mixtures, supporting semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Adsorption-Type Negative Pressure Gas Ion Implantation Source (T-ion)
High-purity gas mixtures including AsH3, PH3, and SiF4
Micro-decontamination systems for toxic gas reduction
F2 mixed gas for excimer lasers

regional_presence.Japan: Takachiho Trading is the only domestic manufacturer of gas sources for ion implantation in Japan, with a strong focus on local production and service.
